verses.text: For the music director. By David. The fool says in their heart, “There is no God.” People are corrupt and do terrible things. No one does good.
The LORD looks down from heaven on humanity to see if anyone understands and seeks God.
Everyone has turned away. Together they’ve become corrupt. No one does good. No one at all.
Don’t any of these evildoers understand? They devour my people as casually as they eat bread, and they never call on the LORD.
But there they are, terrified, because God is with those who do what is right.
You try to ruin the plans of the poor, but the LORD is their refuge.
If only Israel’s rescue would come from Zion! When the LORD restores his people’s fortunes, Jacob will rejoice and Israel will be glad.
